§6Power Core (Medium)§f

§aMid-tier upgrade core. Your Powercells are about to get a serious upgrade.§f

The §bPower Core (Medium)§f is used to craft §bPowercell (Medium)§f blocks. A 9×9×9 Medium network can push §e182,250 RF/t§f per side, plenty for most mid-game setups. Each Powercell (Medium) needs 4 cores plus an emerald in the center slot. Dimensional Shards substitute for Redstone in the recipe, so check your reserves before crafting.

§6Crafting§f: §b1 Emerald§f (center) + §b1 Redstone Block§f (top) + §b4 Redstone or Dimensional Shards§f

Dimensional Shards come from RFTools Dimensions, so if you haven't set up a dimension yet, stick with Redstone.

§9Note:§f The Copy NBT upgrade path (Low to Medium to High) preserves stored energy. Plan your swap during low-load moments.
